title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas: Forecasting Electricity Demand

primary_sources.paraphrase: arXiv abstract (16 Oct 2026): online covariate-conditioned vine copula for multivariate distributional forecasts; on net demand in five GB regions it beats unconditional Gaussian and vine copula benchmarks; algorithm is in the ondil package.

Full text: half-hourly GB net demand 2014-2018 (data from Gioia et al. replication material), five macro-regions, test year 2018 in monthly blocks, one-step-ahead, weather covariates of unstated provenance; scores are averages with model confidence set p-values, no intervals.
ondil: Python package for online distributional regression, GPL-3.0, no releases listed, no pretrained weights; fits models on user data.

claims.text: Conditional vine copula with online updating gives the best log score among nine copula/updating combinations on GB regional net demand (3.8028 vs 3.8358 for the best unconditional vine copula, lower is better).
claims.dataset: GB net demand, 5 regions, half-hourly, test year 2018

claims.text: Conditional vine copula outperforms unconditional Gaussian and vine copula benchmarks on net demand across five GB regions.

relevance.rationale: Regional GB net demand is electricity load but half-hourly and net of embedded generation, not hourly PJM zonal load (2). Horizon is one step ahead (30 min), not a week (1). Weather covariates are used but the paper does not say whether they are actuals or issued forecasts (2, not 3).

checks.notes: Pre-registration: not mentioned in the full text read (first ~100k of 135k characters; the tail was not read). Replication: search found no third-party replication; the authors' own package is named at github.com/chrischu12/online-vine-copulas, listed in the ledger but not opened. Training overlap: no weights exist (model is fitted on user data), so unknown/not applicable. Unverified: weather input type, exact training period, and anything in the unread tail of the HTML. The comparison is between copula structures with the same marginal model, not against a regression or foundation model. ondil is GPL-3.0; its page did not mention vine copulas, so where the conditional vine copula code lives (ondil release vs the replication repo) is unconfirmed. Evidence strength moderate: public code and a full-year test, but no intervals and no replication; the headline is a probabilistic multivariate score comparison.

label: REJECT
label_reason: The headline claim compares conditional with unconditional vine copulas on one-step-ahead, half-hourly probabilistic forecasts of GB net demand, which does not bear on a week-ahead hourly point forecast against a temperature-only regression. There are no pretrained weights and no model in runnable_models to re-measure it, and running it would need a new probabilistic multi-region pipeline.
implementation_hint: Not runnable through our adapters. Only route: fit ondil's conditional vine copula on PJM zone load plus temperature, which is new work, outputs joint distributions, and has no week-ahead claim to test.
